title: GAUSS: A Workload-Aware Analytical and Monte-Carlo Simulator for LLM Inference Serving
abstract: arXiv:2610.37989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference has become an operational workload that fleets must provision, monitor, and bill against latency service-level objectives (SLOs). A single throughput number cannot answer the questions operators actually face, because generative serving couples two phases with very different service characteristics, continuous batching reshapes the effective service process, and user-visible tail latency can degrade long before aggregate throughput saturates. We present GAUSS, a workload-aware analytical and Monte-Carlo simulator that predicts the full distributions of time-to-first-token (TTFT) and time-between-tokens (TBT), together with the sustainable request rate, for a given workload, engine, and accelerator. translated_title: GAUSS：面向大语言模型推理服务的负载感知解析与蒙特卡洛模拟器
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）推理已成为一种运营性工作负载，集群必须根据延迟服务级别目标（SLO）对其进行容量规划、监控和计费。单一的吞吐量数字无法回答运营者实际面临的问题，因为生成式服务耦合了两个服务特性截然不同的阶段，连续批处理重塑了有效服务过程，而且用户可感知的尾延迟可能在总吞吐量尚未饱和之前就已恶化。我们提出了GAUSS，一个负载感知的解析与蒙特卡洛模拟器，它能够针对给定的工作负载、引擎和加速器，预测首字延迟（TTFT）和字间延迟（TBT）的完整分布，以及可持续请求速率。GAUSS将针对预填充和解码两阶段校准的、阶段特定的延迟曲面与随机到达下的Lindley递推排队模型相结合，并通过集成蒙特卡洛采样来估计性能。
tldr: GAUSS是一个负载感知的解析与蒙特卡洛模拟器，能够为LLM推理服务预测TTFT和TBT的完整延迟分布以及可持续请求速率。
en_tdlr: GAUSS is a workload-aware analytical and Monte-Carlo simulator that predicts the full distributions of TTFT and TBT, along with the sustainable request rate, for LLM inference serving.
